hooks.text: "Some of them have eyes like forge coals and the rest follow them. Put the bright ones down. The Watch pays by the head, when it pays."
"There's always one out in front, shouting orders nobody's given for three hundred years. Shut it up for me."
"Bounty, posted and paid: the big ones that lead the walking dead. Proof is you coming back."
"The ones that burn brightest carry the most of the Ember. Put them out gently, if you can. You can't."
"A big one stood in the road at dusk and saluted the cart. The horse hasn't been right since."
"The big ones wear real legion steel, and we'd like to know it can be cut. Find out. The daughter."

journal: Defeat {n} of the bright-eyed ones in the Old Barrows. Hold a room until one comes to lead the rest (about every fifth wave).
ready: Hand it in at the Lantern Guild's board, inside the Tired Mule in Thornwick.
done: Fewer of the dead in the barrows march in step.
